scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,rag-api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @workspace/finsight dev" "services/rag-api/.venv/Scripts/uvicorn rag_api.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir services/rag-api"
